work: The Meaning Of The Ceremony Of Capping
heading: Liji 40 · Guan Yi 冠義 · The Meaning Of The Ceremony Of Capping · Guan Yi 1 … Guan Yi 6

items.text: Perform all the duties of a son toward your parents.
items.quote: they would require from him the performance of all the duties of a son

items.text: Perform all the duties of a younger brother toward your elder brother.
items.quote: the performance of all the duties of a son, a younger brother, a subject, and a junior

items.text: As a junior, perform all duties of deference and submission toward your seniors.
items.quote: the performance of all the duties of a son, a younger brother, a subject, and a junior

items.text: Once he is capped, treat him as a full-grown man and bow to him.
Provide the capping ceremony for your son when he comes of age, handing him the cup to show he will take your place.
items.quote: The father handed him a special cup in the guests' place.
